# 4-Day Home Workout Plan for Muscle Building & Strength

## Overview
**Goal:** Build muscle and increase strength using bodyweight exercises
**Duration:** 4 weeks (with progression guidelines)
**Session Length:** 45-55 minutes
**Recovery:** Rest days between training days

---

## Weekly Schedule

| Day | Focus | Duration |
|-----|-------|----------|
| **Day 1** | Push (Chest, Shoulders, Triceps) | ~50 min |
| **Day 2** | Pull (Back, Biceps) + Core | ~45 min |
| **Day 3** | Rest/Active Recovery | — |
| **Day 4** | Lower Body (Legs, Glutes) | ~50 min |
| **Day 5** | Full Body Strength | ~50 min |
| **Day 6-7** | Rest | — |

---

## Day 1: PUSH

### Warm-up (5 minutes)
- Arm circles: 30 seconds each direction
- Shoulder rolls: 30 seconds
- Scapular push-ups: 10 reps
- Cat-cow stretches: 10 reps

### Main Workout

| Exercise | Sets × Reps | Rest |
|----------|------------|------|
| **Push-ups** (standard or incline) | 4 × 8-12 | 90 sec |
| **Pike Push-ups** (shoulders) | 3 × 6-10 | 90 sec |
| **Diamond Push-ups** (triceps) | 3 × 8-12 | 60 sec |
| **Tricep Dips** (chair/bed) | 3 × 8-12 | 60 sec |
| **Push-up to T-Rotation** | 3 × 10 each side | 45 sec |

### Cool-down (5 minutes)
- Chest doorway stretch: 30 sec each side
- Tricep stretch: 30 sec each arm

---

## Day 2: PULL + CORE

### Warm-up (5 minutes)
- Jumping jacks: 30 seconds
- Arm swings: 30 seconds
- Cat-cow: 10 reps
- Dead bugs: 10 reps

### Main Workout

| Exercise | Sets × Reps | Rest |
|----------|------------|------|
| **Inverted Rows** (under table) | 4 × 8-12 | 90 sec |
| **Doorway Pull-ups** (if available) or **Resistance Band Rows** | 4 × 6-10 | 90 sec |
| **Reverse Snow Angels** (prone) | 3 × 12-15 | 60 sec |
| **Plank** | 3 × 30-60 sec | 60 sec |
| **Superman Holds** | 3 × 20-30 sec | 60 sec |
| **Bicycle Crunches** | 3 × 15-20 each side | 45 sec |

### Cool-down (5 minutes)
- Child's pose: 45 seconds
- Cat stretch: 45 seconds

---

## Day 3: ACTIVE RECOVERY
- Light walking: 20-30 minutes, OR
- Yoga/stretching routine: 20-30 minutes, OR
- Easy-paced sports activity

**Focus:** Mobility and blood flow without taxing muscles

---

## Day 4: LOWER BODY

### Warm-up (5 minutes)
- Leg swings: 10 each direction per leg
- Bodyweight squats: 15 reps
- Glute bridges: 10 reps
- Hip circles: 10 each direction

### Main Workout

| Exercise | Sets × Reps | Rest |
|----------|------------|------|
| **Bodyweight Squats** | 4 × 12-15 | 90 sec |
| **Bulgarian Split Squats** (rear foot elevated) | 3 × 10 each leg | 90 sec |
| **Glute Bridges**

# 4-Day Personalized Strength & Muscle Building Plan

## Profile Summary
- **BMI:** 26.5 (slightly overweight) | **Goal:** Hypertrophy + Strength
- **Key Consideration:** Lower back issues require modified exercises and careful form
- **Session Limit:** 45 minutes (includes warm-up/cool-down)

---

## Weekly Schedule Overview

| Day | Focus | Duration |
|-----|-------|----------|
| **Monday** | Upper Body Push | 45 min |
| **Tuesday** | Lower Body (Back-Friendly) | 45 min |
| **Wednesday** | Rest/Light Activity | — |
| **Thursday** | Upper Body Pull | 45 min |
| **Friday** | Lower Body + Core | 45 min |
| **Sat-Sun** | Rest or Active Recovery | — |

---

## 🏋️ MONDAY: Upper Body Push

**Warm-up (5 min):** Arm circles, band pull-aparts, 5 min light cardio

| Exercise | Sets | Reps | Rest | Notes |
|----------|------|------|------|-------|
| **Dumbbell Bench Press** (Flat) | 4 | 6-8 | 2 min | Primary strength builder |
| **Incline Dumbbell Press** | 3 | 8-10 | 90 sec | Chest and front shoulders |
| **Dumbbell Shoulder Press** | 3 | 8-10 | 90 sec | Seated to reduce back strain |
| **Tricep Dips** (Assisted if needed) | 3 | 8-10 | 60 sec | Use machine or bench |
| **Lateral Raises** (Dumbbells) | 2 | 12-15 | 60 sec | Light weight, high reps |

**Cool-down (2 min):** Chest and shoulder stretches

---

## 🏋️ TUESDAY: Lower Body (Back-Friendly)

**Warm-up (5 min):** Glute bridges, leg swings, bodyweight squats

| Exercise | Sets | Reps | Rest | Notes |
|----------|------|------|------|-------|
| **Goblet Squats** | 4 | 8-10 | 2 min | Easier on lower back than barbell |
| **Romanian Deadlifts** (Light) | 3 | 8-10 | 90 sec | Hinge at hips, slight knee bend—CRITICAL for back |
| **Leg Press** (Machine) | 3 | 10-12 | 90 sec | Controlled descent, avoid locking knees |
| **Leg Curls** (Machine) | 3 | 10-12 | 60 sec | Protects lower back |
| **Calf Raises** (Machine or Standing) | 2 | 12-15 | 60 sec | Lighter load |

**Cool-down (2 min):** Hip flexor and hamstring stretches

---

## 🏋️ THURSDAY: Upper Body Pull

**Warm-up (5 min):** Cat-cow stretches, dead hangs (10-15 sec), band rows

| Exercise | Sets | Reps | Rest | Notes |
|----------|------|------|------|-------|
| **Assisted Pull-ups or Lat Pulldowns** | 4 | 6-8 | 2 min | Primary strength builder |
| **Dumbbell Rows** (Single Arm) | 3 | 8-10 | 90 sec | Supports unilateral strength balance |
| **Chest-Supported Row** (Machine) | 3 | 8-10 | 90 sec | Removes lower back stress entirely |
| **Barbell Curls** or **Dumbbell Curls** | 3 | 8-10 | 60 sec | Strict form, no swinging |
| **Face Pulls** (Cable) | 2 | 12-15 | 60 sec | Shoulder health and rear delts
